strategies.name: mundane
strategies.about: rifleman, rifleman, harpooner repeated; never builds occult

strategies.name: occult
strategies.about: rifleman, then elder_sign / necronomicon_reader alternating; cap guard 30, a blocked item becomes a rifleman (3 per run), then upgrade-or-save; buys sanity

strategies.name: mixed
strategies.about: rifleman, rifleman, elder_sign, rifleman, harpooner, necronomicon_reader repeated; cap guard 60, a blocked occult item is skipped; buys sanity

strategies.name: madness
strategies.about: necronomicon_reader / elder_sign alternating, no guard, never buys sanity: builds past cap 0
